summary: Members get 20% off list price in integer cents. Regular customers keep list price. The unit price now depends on productId and membershipTier.

intent.objective: Add a 20% member discount computed from the server-side customer membershipTier, without changing nonmember prices.

assumptions.rationale: Discount arithmetic is in integer USD cents.

contractChanges.explanation: The unit price now varies by customer membershipTier as well as product.
Customers with membershipTier member receive 20% off list price.

preservedInvariants: The quote response schema is unchanged.
